mcqs.question: When was the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launched, and by whom?
options: August 30, 2026, by NASA on a SpaceX rocket
August 27, 2026, by NASA on a SpaceX rocket
October 1, 2026, by Google on a SpaceX rocket
mcqs.explanation: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope was launched on August 30, 2026, by NASA on a SpaceX rocket. October 1, 2026, and Transporter-18 relate to Google’s Project Suncatcher, not this telescope.

mcqs.keyword: First orbital test and launch vehicle
mcqs.question: When and on which mission was Google’s Project Suncatcher scheduled for its first orbital test?
options: October 1, 2026, with a prototype satellite with Planet on SpaceX Transporter-18
August 30, 2026, with a prototype satellite with Planet on a SpaceX rocket
October 1, 2026, with a prototype satellite with NASA on SpaceX Transporter-18
August 27, 2026, with a prototype satellite with Planet on SpaceX Transporter-18
mcqs.explanation: Project Suncatcher’s first orbital test was scheduled for October 1, 2026, using a prototype satellite with Planet on SpaceX Transporter-18. August 30, 2026, is the launch date of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, while NASA is not the partner identified for this test.
